changelog: v11.0.0 — New Fusion SQL module: read-only SQL workbench for Oracle Fusion through a BI Publisher runner (SQL Builder with parameters and date picker, Saved Queries in APEX, Tables List schema browser, Excel/CSV/PDF export, charts, API Inspector). Ask AI agent with full dictionary access (objects, columns, PL/SQL source, dependencies, sample queries). APEX Data: save results as FSQ_ tables with their source SQL, refresh (REPLACE/APPEND) and query back in a two-pane explorer. Fusion Setups: module-wise setup checklist with check SQL, DONE/NOT DONE per pod and drill-down. Inventory Query Onhand: Export to Excel.
